question: Under what condition must a teaching be given to one who has previously accomplished it after testing over the course of one year?
premises: A teaching is marked as something to be given.
The recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one year before receiving it.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test.
uncertainties: The nature of the test is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has previously accomplished it and has been tested for one year.
